title: vortex-jepa: analysis and evaluation code for forward physical closure of predictive and reconstructive latents for vortex-gust airfoil interactions at Re=5000
description: Reduced-order-model and evaluation code, configuration files, the v2 data-split manifest, and the committed analysis outputs that regenerate the tables and figures of the associated Journal of Fluid Mechanics manuscript. Compares a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), a reconstructive observable-augmented autoencoder, and a POD basis as reduced states for parametric vortex-gust airfoil interactions, judged by forward physical closure of six observables. The raw direct numerical simulation data (SOD2D solver) are owned by the simulation collaborators and are NOT included.
